main_measure.name: t of mean of forecast/10 x excess 2-bar return on regime cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 200 cases and correlation > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 200 cases

supporting_check.name: Pearson correlation of forecast with excess 2-bar return

decided_by: The mean is positive with t >= 2 over at least 200 cases and the correlation is above 0.
reading: Cases are all regime mean_reversion bars with non-zero forecast and a 2-bar forward close inside the window, each counted once, with the coin's mean 2-bar return taken on a non-overlapping grid (positions 0,2,4,...) pooled over all its windows; settlement bars are those whose next bar starts at 00/08/16 UTC.
